title: Opinionated LLM Integration StarterKit: lightweight Next.js / FastAPI / Go / CLI patterns for retries & streaming ergonomics
creator: Avery Chen
description: Deliver a compact, opinionated starter kit that demonstrates low-friction LLM integration patterns across TypeScript (Next.js), Python (FastAPI), Go (HTTP server), and a cross-platform CLI. Focus areas: ergonomic streaming helpers (resumeable streams, client-side backpressure), deterministic retry semantics (idempotency, exponential backoff, safe defaults), and copy-paste-ready cookbook snippets for common app patterns (search augmentation, summaries, chat with tool-calling). Goal is to reduce ramp time for engineers adding Redwood-powered features and to standardize best-practice approaches across SDKs.
acceptance_criteria: Three runnable example apps (Next.js streaming page, FastAPI server+background task, Go HTTP server) with clear READMEs and Dockerfiles
A small CLI example that shows resuming a streaming response, progress UX, and safe retries for partial failures
SDK-level retry helper available in Python/TS/Go with documentation: default retryable errors, idempotency key guideline, and configurable backoff
Streaming ergonomic helpers in each SDK (TS: ReadableStream wrapper, Python: async iterator helper, Go: context-aware chunk reader) with minimal API surface
Automated smoke tests that validate end-to-end streaming and retry behavior in CI (happy path + simulated transient failures)
Design doc and short cookbook snippets covering trade-offs (SSE vs WebSocket vs edge streaming, at-least-once vs deduplication strategies)
Docs cross-linked from SDK README and Console quickstart so customers can find examples from onboarding flows
